lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 high-contrast vertical white lines are visible across the dark grey torso; spacing is widest at the mid-section and becomes progressively narrower toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation occurs on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting in the upper 1/3 of the lateral torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 2, 6, and 8 show clear discontinuities, terminating mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A small cluster of 2-3 distinct white spots is located on the upper-middle posterior haunch area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging laterally at approximately 30-40 degrees from the skull base before curving inward and upward toward a vertical terminal orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 10-15% of the total visible vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the eyes; two high-contrast white spots on the lower cheek/jaw area; white dorsal mane running from the neck to the tail base.
